data.body: [P1] Apply bounded peer cleanup to all invocation fatals. Root-handler and result-delivery fatals are not stored in `pluginFatal`, so this returns immediately; `close()` then uses an unbounded `userHandlerFuture.get()` for any running asynchronous operation. An interrupt-ignoring branch can therefore prevent the fatal from escaping until Lambda times out. Pass the selected fatal into this cleanup path or record all invocation fatals before finalization, and add a regression with a root-handler fatal plus a blocked peer operation.
